say:1:1131055001:0.text: Me? Oh, just thinking of those I'll never see again.
say:1:1131055001:0.source_cn: 我……？呵呵，只是在怀念见不到的人罢了。
say:1:1131055001:0.male: Me? Oh, just thinking of those I'll never see again.
say:1:1131055001:0.female: Me? Oh, just thinking of those I'll never see again.

say:2:1131055002:0.text: My brother, sister, friends from nearby... none will ever come back.
say:2:1131055002:0.source_cn: 我的弟弟、妹妹，隔壁的老大哥，还有他家的小子……都回不来了。
say:2:1131055002:0.male: My brother, sister, friends from nearby... none will ever come back.
say:2:1131055002:0.female: My brother, sister, friends from nearby... none will ever come back.

say:3:1131055003:0.text: To be honest... I'm not really sure if I should feel lucky to have made it home alive.
say:3:1131055003:0.source_cn: 真不知道，我活着回来，到底是幸运还是不幸。
say:3:1131055003:0.male: To be honest... I'm not really sure if I should feel lucky to have made it home alive.
say:3:1131055003:0.female: To be honest... I'm not really sure if I should feel lucky to have made it home alive.

choice_prompt:4:1131055003.female: To be honest... I'm not really sure if I should feel lucky to have made it home alive.

say:6:1131055005:0.text: Please just let me be alone to sit in the quiet.
say:6:1131055005:0.source_cn: 就让我一个人安静地待着吧。
say:6:1131055005:0.male: Please just let me be alone to sit in the quiet.
say:6:1131055005:0.female: Please just let me be alone to sit in the quiet.

say:8:1131055006:0.text: I'm trying not to think at all.
say:8:1131055006:0.male: I'm trying not to think at all.
say:8:1131055006:0.female: I'm trying not to think at all.

say:9:1131055007:0.text: It was my sister who'd always sit here and look out at the view. I'd never really appreciated it.
say:9:1131055007:0.source_cn: 是我妹妹喜欢站在这儿看风景，虽然我一直不知道有什么好看的。
say:9:1131055007:0.male: It was my sister who'd always sit here and look out at the view. I'd never really appreciated it.
say:9:1131055007:0.female: It was my sister who'd always sit here and look out at the view. I'd never really appreciated it.

say:10:1131055008:0.text: But sitting here now does provide a sense of calm I've been missing.
say:10:1131055008:0.source_cn: 不过现在，待在这儿确实能让我平静一点。
say:10:1131055008:0.male: But sitting here now does provide a sense of calm I've been missing.
say:10:1131055008:0.female: But sitting here now does provide a sense of calm I've been missing.
